response.message: As Astra, I read “I will now proceed with writing and executing this script” as a promise, not yet a scene. Your ACT stops at `correct_eq =`; I can't infer execution. One fictional revision: “I'll fix it,” Mira said. Jo lifted the suitcase. “Before or after I leave?” The cursor blinked after the equals sign. To me, this gives the repeated promise a consequence. Would you keep that departure or choose another pressure, then enact your choice in four scene lines in ACT?
